member.name: T:DotNetCore.HayateOP.OpenTelemetry.HayateOtelMetrics
member.summary:
Bridges events to (the .NET built-in Metrics API and the native data source for the OpenTelemetry .NET SDK).
Metric inventory:
Counter HayatePoolAcquire — borrow count (tag: pool.name)
Counter HayatePoolRelease — return count (tag: pool.name, valid)
Counter HayatePoolMiss — miss count (object creation required) (tag: pool.name)
Counter HayatePoolScaled — scaling event count (tag: pool.name, action)
Histogram HayatePoolWaitTime — borrow wait time in milliseconds (tag: pool.name)
ObservableGauge HayatePoolSize — current capacity of each pool (tag: pool.name)
ObservableGauge HayatePoolAvailable — current available (idle) objects of each pool (tag: pool.name)
This package has zero external NuGet dependencies: is built into the .NET 6+ base class library (System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource). Consumers bring their own OpenTelemetry SDK + Exporter (OTLP / Prometheus / InMemory …) to subscribe to the "DotNetCore.HayateOP" Meter; without an SDK, dotnet-counters can observe it directly.
Decoupling constraint: this class does not access any internal pool state — events come via the callbacks, and gauges are read from the public + .

member.name: T:DotNetCore.HayateOP.Prometheus.HayatePrometheusExporter
member.summary:
Serializes each pool's into the Prometheus text format.
The data source is the public + ; it never touches internal pool state, and a single pool failing to read does not affect the overall output (that pool is skipped).
Exposed metric families (the prefix is configurable via ):
hayateop_pool_size (gauge) — live objects per pool (idle + borrowed)
hayateop_pool_available (gauge) — current idle objects per pool
hayateop_pool_created_total / _released_total / _acquired_total / _missed_total (counter)
hayateop_pool_leak_detected_total / _leak_suspected_total (counter)
hayateop_pool_wait_average_milliseconds / _lease_average_milliseconds (gauge)
hayateop_pool_acquire_allocated_bytes_average / _release_allocated_bytes_average (gauge, only present on pools with allocation tracking enabled)

member.summary:
Prometheus text format (exposition format 0.0.4) serializer.
Zero external dependencies — does not pull in prometheus-net or the OTel Prometheus exporter package; it only emits # HELP / # TYPE / metric{label="v"} value per the Prometheus text protocol. Consumers can either expose it directly via an endpoint or write the text to any scraping channel themselves.

member.summary:
Registers the OpenTelemetry bridge metrics (overriding the EmptyHayateMetrics default from AddHayatePoolSupport()) and lets it observe each pool's capacity through the container's (populated by RegisterHayatePool<T>).
This method only publishes the metrics to System.Diagnostics.Metrics; the consumer side (OpenTelemetry SDK + Exporter / dotnet-counters) is wired up by the caller, e.g.: builder.Services.AddOpenTelemetry().WithMetrics(m => m.AddMeter("DotNetCore.HayateOP")).
